name: Ozark Outdoors Resort
description: Resort near Leasburg with a mile of Meramec riverfront, floating the Meramec, the Huzzah and the Courtois with canoes, kayaks, rafts and river tubes. Courtois routes include the 10-mile Butts Slab run and a seasonal 5-mile Courtois Primitive trip. Camping and cabins on site.

name: Bass River Resort
description: The Courtois specialist at Steelville, running 6-mile (Blunts to Bass'), 7-mile (Berryman to Blunts, or Bass' to Scotia) and 13-mile (Berryman to Bass') trips, with multi-day floats of 20 to 25 miles. Canoes, single and tandem kayaks and rafts, all with shuttle. Camping, cabins, meals and horseback riding on site.

name: Berryman Campground
description: Eight-site Forest Service campground on the site of a 1937 CCC camp, at the trailhead for the Berryman Trail and the Courtois Section of the Ozark Trail. It is the upstream put-in for the Courtois float trips run out of Steelville. Each site has a concrete pad, picnic table, lantern post and fire ring; vault toilets and no drinking water.
